generated_discovery.interpretation: Discovery only; no complete generated campaign score is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Literal execution, arguments, exit codes and signals
requirements.details: Four fixed signatures return five-field maps only after complete I/O and reaping. Text is strict UTF-8; binary input/output is exact. Nonzero exit and signals are results. No implicit shell or argument splitting.

requirements.requirement: Environment and directory isolation in Engine, CLI and imports
requirements.details: Uses immutable run snapshots, per-call overlay/removal/clear semantics and native PATH lookup; no process-global mutation. CLI captures host snapshots during blocking preparation, including case and suite owner contexts.

requirements.requirement: Bounded command, input, capture, live overlap and ownership
requirements.details: Preflight precedes command/input copying and launch. Captures and maximum result are admitted under run value/temporary quotas. Global 64 MiB logical bytes and 32 processes, command/input 1 MiB each, command entries 16384. Pending and unverified ownership retain leases. Native command overlap conservatively accounts for three payload copies.

requirements.requirement: Deadlines, cancellation, drop and executor progress
requirements.details: Local timeouts latch the containing run without cancelling its parent; Finally uses independent cleanup. Async waits occupy native workers; synchronous waits use a Condvar waker without a nested runtime. Direct-child PID tests verify reaping.

requirements.requirement: Documentation, catalogue compatibility and independent tests
requirements.details: Catalogue 93, B6 conformance rule with three cases, reference and example 33 executed. Snapshot-count checks, coverage file inventory, mutation scope and 23 exact semantic faults updated. All 1670 tests pass on GNU/musl debug/release; 100 two-lane repetitions provide 2300 process-test passes.

limits: Linux process groups and direct-child reaping; deliberately detached descendants require the separate guardian/namespace API.
Cleanup allowance bounds observation; stalled OS work retains ownership and can outlive the call. No successful partial result or background process handle is exposed.
Logical byte limits exclude allocator/thread/kernel overhead. Native OS argument/environment restrictions can reject otherwise admitted commands.
